chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Ḥammād ibn ʿĪsā, from Ḥarīz, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:
Abu ʿAbdillah عليه السلام said: Do not speak when you have commenced the iqamah for the salat, for if you speak, you must repeat the iqamah.

key_terms.أَقَمْتَ: you commenced the iqamah for prayer
key_terms.الْإِقَامَةَ: the iqamah, the call immediately preceding congregational prayer

ai.seo_question: Does speaking during the iqamah invalidate it and require it to be repeated?
ai.summary: This hadith states that one should not speak after beginning the iqamah for salat. If speech occurs during that state, the iqamah must be repeated, indicating the legal seriousness and ritual etiquette of preparing for prayer.
